title: Data does not upload to Nightscout after switch the Insulin type to Lyumjev
symptom: After switching insulin type to Lyumjev in AAPS configuration builder, the child's phone does not upload data to Nightscout and Dexcom Follow app stops showing sugar data, although the child sees data on the phone. Switching back to rapid insulin resolves the issue.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. A maintainer suggests there must be a different reason, and another user notes that manually setting the time (due to clock change and Google Family Link) can cause synchronization troubles.
fix: Switching back to rapid insulin resolved the issue. Additionally, the maintainer advises to avoid manually setting time as it can cause synchronization problems.
evidence_quote: Only After we switched back to "rapid insulin" everything worked out and we could see data in Nightscout site and in the Dexcom Follow app
